source_label_definition.0: Original publisher/curator legitimate or ham label; identities are not independently authenticated.
source_label_definition.1: Inherited Kaggle positive label, including spam and fraud as well as phishing. Not uniformly verified credential phishing.

data_manifest.label_scope_limit: ID metrics measure this original broad positive task. They cannot establish strict phishing-specific accuracy without human relabeling.
data_manifest.source_attribution: Supplied Kaggle Phish No More; cite Al-Subaiey et al. (2024); underlying six corpus families recorded per row.
data_manifest.english_eligibility: Lingua 2.2.0, full 75-language detector, prepared model text only; confidence >=0.95, margin >=0.20, >=8 alphabetic words; fallible metadata not human truth.
data_manifest.pool_policy: Retain original grouped 70/15/15 membership; filter and quarantine inside those pools, then allocate disjoint new roles.
data_manifest.sample_policy: Whole groups, seed42 greedy, smallest unused matching groups added to meet minimum; exact observed counts reported.

external_admission.TREC06: provisional; original ham truth linkage and original reuse terms not fully verified; not in scored tests

data_manifest.development: Fixed choices from separately documented prior development; no new development role or test-based tuning in this corrected attempt.
data_manifest.baseline: Existing train-only weights reused on byte-identical English training inputs.

development_selection.selection_policy: common prompt by mean valid rate then mean accuracy then latency; candidate by valid rate then accuracy then latency; DistilBERT by latency among parity-passing variants

development_selection.selection_origin: Carried forward unchanged from prior validation-only development; its reported quality is not an independent evaluation.

human_review.quality_denominator: Only available explanations with a human score for that dimension; missing and uncertain scores are excluded, never zero-filled.
human_review.interpretation: Descriptive ordinal-scale means and medians for this fixed borderline sample and submitted reviewer judgments; no independent second review or inter-rater agreement was collected. No confidence intervals or gate changes are inferred from these ratings.

decision.weight_sensitivity: not_applicable_no_survivors; frozen +/-10 point shifts cannot repair missing hard-gate evidence

qualitative_error_reading_record.reviewer_type: AI engineering agent qualitative error reading

definition.name: real_phishing_challenge
definition.publisher_label_definition: 1: publisher hand-classified phishing; possible annotation errors acknowledged by the collector.
definition.license: CC BY 4.0, declared by the original mailbox publisher
definition.date_limit: Header date is a claimed message date, not proof of content novelty or authenticated receipt.
definition.selection: Whole groups, sorted input IDs, seed42, target100 positives; no score-based selection.
definition.source_checks: Full original Kaggle exact/near/passage quarantine; all public checkpoint email splits excluded by exact/near/group evidence; additional publisher-to-candidate shared-passage quarantine.
definition.purpose: Estimate recall on collected English publisher-phishing examples, with grouped bootstrap uncertainty.
definition.original_test_ood: Incomplete; no admitted independent negative population. This challenge does not fill a missing negative arm.
definition.original_test_adv: Unassessed; natural structural flags are not human-certified evasion intent or genuine bank/OTP controls.
